topic: Paying for a storage unit for years vs clearing it out in one day (Duke vs Verity)

scenes.narration: Two thousand a year to store things you never touch. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at a storage unit door with a price tag reading TWO THOUSAND A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duke and Verity each rent a hundred sixty dollar storage unit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man duke and woman verity locking identical storage units labeled ONE SIXTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both packed them three years ago after a rushed move.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a dusty calendar reading THREE YEARS beside boxes stacked to the ceiling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neither has opened that door in eighteen straight months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a cobwebbed padlock with a hanging tag reading EIGHTEEN MONTHS UNOPENED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Duke keeps paying because sorting it feels overwhelming.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man duke slumped on a couch ignoring a storage key, a mountain of boxes looming behind him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His unit has now cost fifty seven hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man duke crushed under a barbell stamped FIFTY SEVEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The stuff inside is worth maybe nine hundred used.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a price tag reading WORTH NINE HUNDRED hanging on a pile of old furniture, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Verity blocks one Saturday and empties her unit completely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman verity in workout clothes hauling boxes out of a storage unit, a clock reading ONE SATURDAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sells, donates, and keeps only two boxes at home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman verity beside a SOLD pile, a DONATE pile, and two neatly labeled keeper boxes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The sale brings six hundred and the monthly bill stops.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman verity holding six hundred in cash beside an invoice stamped CANCELED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later she is twenty five hundred dollars ahead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman verity flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading TWENTY FIVE HUNDRED AHEAD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: If it stayed shut a year, clear it out. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading EMPTY THE UNIT, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
